mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP3 and TP4 are supported as direct bacterial membrane-perturbing peptides against V. vulnificus.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The conclusion is qualitative/assay-class level; exact plotted fluorescence values were not promoted from the figure image.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP3 and TP4 show in vivo anti-infective efficacy in tilapia challenged with V. vulnificus.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: TP3 and TP4 in hybrid tilapia
mechanism_claims.limitations: Survival/bacterial-load figures support efficacy context but are not database MIC/MBC rows.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP3 and TP4 alter host immune-response gene expression in liver and spleen after treatment or infection challenge.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is host-response context, not a direct antimicrobial killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: TP3/TP4 can reduce antibiotic MIC requirements in combination with ampicillin or kanamycin against V. vulnificus.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Combination effect is preserved as context; no FICI value is reported in local tables.

evidence_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from primary XML figures/methods/results and supplementary qPCR text.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Image-only figure values are kept qualitative unless exact values are stated in text or tables.
qPCR host immune effects are not promoted to direct antimicrobial mechanism.
